## Line 87

**Source:** [stdlib/geometry/brep.library.plato, line 87](../../../../../stdlib/geometry/brep.library.plato#L87).

```plato

    // A shell is watertight when every edge is cited exactly twice, once in
    // each direction — the edge-use form of "closed 2-manifold".
    IsWatertight(b: Brep3D): Boolean
        => MapRange(b.Edges.Count, i => UndirectedEdgeIndex(i))
            .All(e => b.ForwardUseCount(e) == 1 && b.ReversedUseCount(e) == 1);
```
